mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing response to economic stress, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a deepening housing market collapse, amplifying credit stress and reducing consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline by more than 5% from 6-month highs.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 100), supply chain disruptions and reduced industrial output lead to higher input costs and lower corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts delayed Fed rate cuts, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over 6 months indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals severe labor market contraction, amplifying recession fears and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls by more than 0.5% from 3-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5%, it indicates a sharp manufacturing slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average by more than 1.5%.
